title: ERP annual sales report crashes with 'Out of Memory'
description: I'm trying to pull the 2023-2024 sales report, it gives 'out of memory' at 85% and crashes.

worklogs.description: Examined the report query in the DB — it consumes over 4GB of RAM due to 3 million rows + joins.
Took an application server JVM heap profile — peak 5.2 GB. Current Xmx is 4 GB.
As an alternative method, converted the report into a scheduled task format, tested successfully.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Hi, when I looked into your report I saw that a wide 2-year date range is being pulled — the query joins ~3 million rows in one pass and the server runs out of RAM. We have three options: (1) split the report into 3-month chunks, run it 8 separate times, and combine in Excel, (2) run it as a scheduled report overnight and receive it by email in the morning, (3) temporarily increase server RAM to 8 GB (may impact production). Which one works for you?

comments.author: customer
comments.message: I need it for tomorrow's management meeting, it has to be in my hands by 9 AM at the latest. I don't think there's time to split and combine.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Understood, time is tight. In that case my recommendation is option 2: if I trigger it now as a scheduled report, it'll finish around 02:00 and land in your inbox at 06:00. As a backup, let me also send you the 4 Excel chunks I prepare before the morning meeting — as a single combined file. Would you like that?

comments.author: customer
comments.message: That would be great, let's do both. I'll see which one I'll use in the meeting. Thanks so much.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Of course. I triggered the scheduled report, it's being monitored. I'm starting to prepare the 4 Excel chunks as well, they'll be in your mailbox by 08:30. If you can follow up after the meeting, let's talk with the team about a long-term solution — I think we should move the report to an OLAP cube.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Customer confirmed, dual-channel solution is in place. After tomorrow's meeting we'll discuss long-term OLAP — this isn't urgent, once the ticket is closed I'll open a separate initiative.
